---
title: "Billboard Analysis"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv")
```

```{r}
# 1. Reshape and filter to songs that reached the Top 10
long_data <- billboard |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"), 
    names_to = "week", 
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    week = as.integer(readr::parse_number(week)),
    song_label = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")
  ) |> 
  group_by(artist, track) |> 
  filter(min(rank) <= 10) |> 
  ungroup()

# 2. Explicitly define the three notable target songs for the legend
notable_songs <- c("Madonna - Music", "Lonestar - Amazed", "Creed - Higher")

plot_data <- long_data |> 
  mutate(highlight_song = ifelse(song_label %in% notable_songs, song_label, NA_character_))

# 3. Build the exact matching plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = week, y = rank, group = song_label)) +
  # Background layer: All top-10 songs in light gray
  geom_line(data = filter(plot_data, is.na(highlight_song)), color = "gray85", alpha = 0.6) +
  # Foreground layer: Highlighted target songs with thicker lines
  geom_line(data = filter(plot_data, !is.na(highlight_song)), aes(color = highlight_song), linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(100, 0), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 70), breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60)) +
  # Match the exact plot colors from the image
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Creed - Higher" = "#f8766d",      # Coral/Red
      "Lonestar - Amazed" = "#00ba38",   # Green
      "Madonna - Music" = "#619cff"      # Blue
    )
  ) +
  # Add the text annotations onto the chart area
  annotate("text", x = 11, y = -2, label = "Fastest to #1", color = "#619cff", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 44, y = -2, label = "Slowest to #1", color = "#00ba38", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 50, y = 5, label = "Longest top-10 run", color = "#f8766d", size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Top-10 hits follow different chart paths",
    subtitle = "Each line is one song that reached the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100",
    x = "Weeks since entering the chart",
    y = "Billboard rank",
    color = "Song",
    caption = "Source: tidyr::billboard"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 1, size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
